title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks | TechCrunch
summary: United Airlines said it will restrict access to AI agents seeking to book flights and manage reservations on their users’ behalf, citing a risk to cybersecurity and undermining federal regulations.
